{{Quote|This is Eris Herro from ENS, embedded with the 77th Air Wing at Kelrodo-Ai.|Eris Herro|<ref name="The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref>}}
The '''Eriadu News Service''', also known as '''ENS''', was a news service that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an ENS crew traveled to the war-torn [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]] to interview [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]], an Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[77th Air Wing]] who was leading a campaign to force [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] from the world, as part of the Empire's [[Western Reaches Operation]]. The ENS reporter [[Eris Harro/Legends|Eris Herro]] spoke with Hublin and their coversation was recorded by a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] operator. Once their news report was complete, the News Service team departed from the world.
